interface.longDescription: Read-only EU free-movement and EU-family visa guidance with model-led routing, evidence-gated research, legal-source review, and controlled synthetic eudirective tools. Every substantive legal consultation is instructed to end with a fresh Full or Limited native-Markdown board showing scope, strategy triggers, operation status, selected C27 checks, source use, and relevant modules. Source accounting separates matches to records in the bundled plugin library from sources found through web search, while marking model-reported discovery counts as unknown when provenance is missing. Limited and unavailable items name the missing information and its effect. The board reports model-led work honestly; skill instructions do not authenticate activity or enforce answer release, and the local receipt checker has no ChatGPT host hook. Includes the externally maintained EU and national source library mirrored into the plugin package. The bundled corpus is a versioned snapshot; consult official publishers to confirm live currentness. Personal use is intended. Non-personal use for an employer, business, organization, client, customer or other third party, paid services, or deploying the plugin for others requires a license; request one at eudirective@proton.me.
